units.bv: B minus V color index or null

missingValues: Unknown numeric metadata remains null. Missing proper motion must not be treated as a documented zero.
properMotionConvention: pmra is tangential mu_alpha*cos(delta). Propagate tangent vectors or divide by cos(delta) when calculating coordinate RA drift; avoid pole singularities. HYG Cartesian velocities independently confirm the convention.
attribution: Star data: HYG Database v4.1 by David Nash / Astronexus and contributors.
modifications: Filtered visual magnitude <=6.5; excluded Sun; retained selected fields; compact array encoding; standardized readable Bayer names and aliases; rounded RA/Dec to original six decimals, magnitude/proper motion to two, color index to three. Data derivative remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
notices: Stars share catalog epoch/equinox J2000. Proper motion and epoch transformations are runtime responsibilities.
Source apparent magnitudes can vary for variable stars; the magnitude cutoff does not guarantee actual naked-eye visibility.
Proper names for named secondary components can be unofficial as described in upstream HYG 4.1 notes.
